foreignQualification.feeBasis: Flat regulatory filing fee of $150.00 for the application for registration as a foreign limited liability company (3 AAC 16.065).
foreignQualification.formName: Application for Registration as a Foreign Limited Liability Company
foreignQualification.filedWith: Alaska Department of Commerce, Community, and Economic Development
foreignQualification.ongoingObligationsNote: File a biennial report (due before January 2 of each filing year; $200.00 for a foreign LLC) and continuously maintain a registered office and registered agent in Alaska.

evidence.quote: 3 AAC 16.065. Fees and charges for limited liability companies under AS 10.50 . (a) The fee for a domestic limited liability company filing articles of organization under AS 10.50 or a foreign limited liability company filing an application for registration as a foreign limited liability company under AS 10.50 is $150.

Sec. 10.50.605. Registration required. Before conducting affairs in this state, a foreign limited liability company shall register with the department. To register, the company shall deliver to the department an application for registration as a foreign limited liability company.
(5) department means the Department of Commerce, Community, and Economic Development;

Sec. 10.50.635. Registered office and registered agent of foreign company. A foreign limited liability company registered under this chapter shall have and continuously maintain in the state a registered (1) office that may be, but need not be, the same as its office in this state; and (2) agent, who may be either an individual resident in this state whose business office is identical to the registered office, a corporation organized under AS 10.06 , or a foreign corporation authorized to transact business in this state, that has a business office identical to the registered office.

Sec. 10.50.760. Filing of biennial report. (a) A biennial report required by AS 10.50.750 shall be filed with the department and is due before January 2 of the filing year. A limited liability company filing articles of organization and a foreign limited liability company registering during an even-numbered year shall file the biennial report each even-numbered year.
(c) The fee to file a biennial report for a domestic limited liability company is $100; a foreign limited liability company doing business in this state is $200.

notes: The application fee and the biennial report fee are set by regulation (3 AAC 16.065); AS 10.50.605 names the application for registration as a foreign limited liability company and AS 10.50.990 defines the department. The Department's own site (commerce.alaska.gov) is a script-walled JS challenge on the collecting route, so the official statute and administrative code pages are the cited sources.
